name: Switch Hikvision DS-3E0326P-E/M(B)
summary: 24 × 100 Mbps PoE ports, 1 × 1000 Mbps RJ45 port, and 1 × 1000 Mbps SFP fiber optical port.

description_html:
24 × 100 Mbps PoE ports, 1 × 1000 Mbps RJ45 port, and 1 × 1000 Mbps SFP fiber optical port.

IEEE 802.3at/af standard.

IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, and IEEE 802.3x standard.

High priority ports.

8-core power supply.

Up to 250 m transmission distance.

6 KV surge protection for PoE ports.

PoE power management.

1000 Mbps network access.

Wire-speed forwarding and non-blocking design.

Store-and-forward switching.

Solid high-strength metal shell.
